basics.name: Ranil Mukesh MJ
basics.label: Co-Founder & CTO, PhobosQ & k22.ai
basics.summary: I architect the infrastructure for autonomous enterprise intelligence. Operating at the convergence of advanced machine learning research and high-availability software engineering, I move AI from stochastic, chat-based novelties to deterministic, stateful agentic systems that execute complex business logic at scale.

traits.text: Rigorous testing, multi-tenancy and fault tolerance over mere capability
Deterministic, stateful agents over stochastic chat

highlights.text: Co-Founder & CTO of PhobosQ and k22.ai
SIRUS: an autonomous AI Data Scientist across 3,000+ enterprise tables
Yazhi: a foundational AI platform for 90 million Tamil speakers
11 papers and pre-prints, from agent security to clinical AI

work.name: PhobosQ

responsibilities: Engineered deterministic agentic middleware with Ed25519 cryptographic signatures and governed execution enclaves to prevent logic hijacking and keep tenant data isolated
Designed multi-agent reasoning with governance-graph tool use for SQL generation and insight extraction across SAP, Salesforce and Oracle
Led Yazhi, a foundational AI platform with novel tokenization and RL-based reasoning
Building voice agents with deep CRM integration (Salesforce, SAP) and an AI-native technical interviewing platform for 100k+ concurrent candidates (WebRTC, SSE, distributed caching)

work.name: k22.ai
work.summary: Architected an autonomous agentic MLOps platform that runs the full AI lifecycle from natural language.
responsibilities: Built a scalable, multi-tenant backend on Agent-to-Agent (A2A) orchestration and the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Agents generate and provision Infrastructure-as-Code on AWS (SageMaker, Glue, Terraform)
Integrated AgentOps for real-time agent telemetry

projects.name: SIRUS
projects.description: An autonomous AI Data Scientist agent. Multi-tenant, secure, enterprise-grade. It navigates enterprise databases of more than 3,000 tables (SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce Health Cloud, Oracle) without hallucination.
highlights: Multi-agent reasoning that plans over a governance graph before it touches data
Text-to-SQL and insight extraction directly over ERP data
Multi-tenant, cryptographically isolated auth, with PII redaction before anything reaches a model
MCP connectors, with every query, tool call and answer kept in an audit trail

projects.name: Enterprise Business Context Library
projects.description: A governed, vendor-neutral semantic layer that brokers business context to AI agents. It runs entirely inside an enterprise Microsoft 365 / Azure tenant, and every answer can be traced back to the record it came from.
highlights: “Three records, not one”: where data lives, what it means and who may see it are kept as separate layers
MCP context brokering behind policy-driven access, with sensitive and personal fields classified on the way in
Lineage and audit layer: each retrieved fact, prompt and answer is logged and traceable
Adversarial verification of AI answers (SAFE and chain-of-verification style) before they reach a user

projects.name: Returned-Asset Decision Workbench
projects.description: An agent-first decision-intelligence platform that decides what happens to every returned asset (redeploy, resell, re-lease, harvest parts or a responsible exit) and keeps the full evidence trail behind each call.
highlights: Agents weigh condition, demand forecast and value, inside policy guardrails
Decision ledger: evidence, forecast, approver and outcome recorded for every asset
Human-in-the-loop approvals with role-based views; customer details masked by default
Closes the loop by measuring the value actually realised: executive command centre and operations views

projects.name: Paati OS

highlights: Second prize, 24-hour IEEE hackathon in Chennai (₹1 lakh pool)
Agent team on Agno AgentOS with NVIDIA Nemotron; Sarvam AI speech in and out
Generative UI: lessons and mini-games are rendered as live interface, not text
Explainable placement prediction (XGBoost and SHAP) over a career knowledge graph

Processes orders idempotently and reuses approved repair rules zero-shot

Agno + AgentOS team with hard delegation and anti-looping bounds; graph-native decision context, PostgreSQL, NVIDIA-hosted LLM, Docker

publications.name: HQ-Mamba-PAC: A Generalizable Hybrid Quantum State-Space Framework for High-Fidelity Object Classification
publications.summary: HQ-Mamba-PAC is a hybrid quantum-classical vision framework that combines semantic distillation, quantum encoding, messenger-linked quantum processing, selective state-space fusion, and PAC-Bayesian regularization in one pipeline. The goal is to keep the long-range modeling benefits of advanced vision systems while improving trainability, robustness under domain shift, and theoretical control over generalization, including deployment for non-invasive chick gender classification.

publications.name: Mixture-of-Depths Meets Thresholded Differential Attention: Omni-PAIFT, a Universal Sink-Free Multimodal Foundation Transformer with Gradient-Orthogonal Fusion and Active Uncertainty Routing
publications.summary: Omni-PAIFT is a unified multimodal foundation architecture designed to reduce information dilution, attention sinks, gradient interference, and expensive uncertainty estimation in large-scale systems. It combines threshold-gated mixture-of-depths differential attention, cross-modal fusion, single-pass uncertainty routing, evolutionary multi-task optimization, and speculative sparse execution to improve long-context efficiency and downstream task performance with only modest additional compute.

publications.name: Rhythm in the Air: Real-Time Continuous Gesture-to-Music Generation via Liquid State Dynamics and Flow-Matching
publications.summary: This paper presents a real-time gesture-to-music generation system that turns continuous human motion into expressive audio rather than mapping gestures to fixed pre-recorded outputs. It uses Liquid Time-Constant networks for low-latency motion understanding, an audio-visual mixture-of-experts router for latent control, and flow-matching or diffusion-based generation to synthesize music and vocals on the fly while aligning the system with human aesthetic intent through GDPO.

publications.name: Self-Defending 6G Networks Through AI-Driven Adaptive Decoy Generation at the Edge
publications.summary: This paper proposes an adaptive security framework for 6G networks that moves beyond passive intrusion detection by generating and deploying realistic AI-driven decoys at the network edge. The system combines conditional GANs for context-aware decoy creation, PPO-based reinforcement learning for dynamic decoy placement and resource control, adversarial feedback from attacker interactions for continuous refinement, and federated synchronization across edge nodes to preserve privacy while improving collective defense.

publications.name: CareerCompass: A Privacy-Preserving Agentic Framework for Causal Employability Prediction and Generative Curriculum Synthesis
publications.summary: CareerCompass is a privacy-first employability prediction framework that allows multiple institutions to train a shared model without centralizing sensitive student records. It combines federated learning for decentralized prediction, propensity-score-based causal inference to test whether suggested interventions truly improve employability, and GraphRAG over a knowledge graph to generate personalized learning paths tailored to each student's current skills and career goals.

publications.name: Signed and Sealed: Protocol-Level Isolation with Cryptographic Integrity (PLICI) for Secure LLM Agents
publications.summary: PLICI is a deterministic security middleware for LLM agents that shifts defense away from fragile prompt-level heuristics toward verifiable protocol enforcement. It uses session-scoped Ed25519 signatures to verify data origin, schema-locked enclaves to isolate tool payloads before the agent reads them, and an NLI-based semantic filter to catch logic hijacking, sharply reducing attack success while keeping latency low enough for real-time agent systems.

publications.name: BrepHCC: Lightweight Cross-Modal B-Rep Point Fusion with Hierarchical Contrastive Clustering for Non-Categorical 3D Jewelry CAD Organization
publications.summary: BrepHCC is an unsupervised 3D CAD clustering framework built for large jewelry design repositories, where visual similarity alone is not enough to capture style, topology, and manufacturing structure. It fuses native Rhino B-Rep topology with dense point-cloud features through a lightweight top-2 mixture-of-experts router and trains with a hierarchical contrastive clustering loss that preserves geometric detail, curvature patterns, and cross-model similarity.

publications.name: Cerebro-TabM: Contextual Evidential Retrieval & Ensembling with Bounded Rademacher Optimization for Clinical Stroke Prediction
publications.summary: Cerebro-TabM is a clinical stroke prediction architecture built for highly imbalanced and partially missing healthcare data, where rare positive cases and missing-not-at-random features can mislead standard tabular models. It introduces a missingness-aware tokenizer, an evidential BatchEnsemble that outputs uncertainty-aware Dirichlet evidence, and a PAC-Bayes-grounded focal loss that aims to improve calibration, fairness, and edge-deployment readiness for safety-critical decision support.

publications.name: Cross-Attention with Squeeze-and-Excitation Layers for Tabular Data
publications.summary: This architecture is designed for tabular learning with mixed numerical and categorical features, using a shared embedding space followed by cross-attention to model interactions between feature types. It further applies squeeze-and-excitation recalibration, lightweight feedforward blocks, and efficiency techniques such as blockwise attention, sparse masking, pruning, and quantization to improve performance without making the model too expensive to train or deploy.

publications.name: Generative Causal-Curriculum: A Privacy-Preserving Federated Framework for Synthetic Hard-Example Mining in Brain Tumor Segmentation
publications.summary: This work proposes a federated brain tumor segmentation framework that turns model failure patterns into anonymous causal error vectors instead of sharing raw medical images. A server-side latent diffusion model then generates synthetic hard examples that specifically target those blind spots, while MO-DGPO and TreeGRPO make the optimization more stable and reduce generation overhead for practical federated training.

publications.name: HelixVantage: Context-Aware Medical Orchestration via Semantic IoT-Edge Fusion and Dynamic Neural Routing
publications.summary: HelixVantage is a hierarchical medical AI orchestration system that grounds language-based reasoning in live physiological signals rather than relying only on static text retrieval. It converts edge sensor streams into HL7 FHIR observations, combines those signals with user queries through a context-aware router, and applies a safety-oriented regularizer so the final response stays closer to clinical guidelines while reducing hallucinations.
